sections.title: Owner direction — CI ignored, audit waiver extended — 2026-10-04
sections.text:
Source: actual user messages in the current conversation (task:plan-run P07.1).

The owner wrote, twice, while P07.1 admission was blocked by hosted-CI state (D94 п.2):

> изнорируй CI

When asked (in Russian, with detail) how to proceed with the design-audit gate after the design fingerprint
moved 6c53c420… → 2a5b824d… (P06 close/D105 edits to @plan/plan.json), the owner selected the option:

> Продлить waiver (рекомендую)

That option stated: record a new decision with the same waiver for the new fingerprint, citing the owner's D104
phrase («аудит уже был, больше не надо»), run Task finish, then run P07.1; no new audits, reviews or subagents;
hosted CI is ignored.

Scope: (1) the repeated whole-plan design audit is waived for the new fingerprint (not an audit-green verdict);
(2) the D94 п.2 / P07 DoR start prerequisite «P06 GREEN on hosted CI» is not a gate for starting P07.1.
Not waived: item Validation, producer dependencies, Routing, phase checkpoints, terminal admission, independent
reviews required by the plan (Review P07).
